{{Quote|One day this slaver was particularly hard on one Wookiee, treating him so badly I couldn't stand by and watch. I'd heard the phrase, 'It's none of your business,' one too many times, so I took action. My good deed was rewarded. I was court-martialed and booted from the majestic Imperial Navy. But here's the catch. Chewbacca here was that Wookiee. And my intervention in his life, by making him my business, had established his 'life debt' to me. Some Wookiee custom, that. He was ready to follow me anywhere, and he did.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars Journal: Hero for Hire">''[[Star Wars Journal: Hero for Hire]]''</ref>}}
'''Chewbacca ''' (or "'''Chewie'''," as he was known to his friends) was a legendary [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], best known for being the co-pilot of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. He was the son of [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], the husband of [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], and the father of [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]]. Chewbacca carried with him the name of an ancient Wookiee hero, the great [[Bacca]], first of the great chieftains of Kashyyyk, and the creator of a [[Bacca's Ceremonial Blade|sword]] that denoted leadership among the Wookiees. This name placed Chewbacca in a noble lineage, which was further supported by his role in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Born in [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], Chewbacca became a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] of the [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac Guild]] and fought alongside [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] at the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but was condemned to [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Rescued by Han Solo, Chewbacca swore a [[Life debt/Legends|life-debt]] to Solo and accompanied him throughout his [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] career. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Solo and Chewbacca fell in with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and flew at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. After the battle, Chewbacca was considered a hero of the Alliance, and he played a role in key victories against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|declaration]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Chewbacca became the protector of Han and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo's]] children, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]]. Chewbacca died in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the first year of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], giving his life during the [[Destruction of Sernpidal]] to save Anakin Solo.

Chewbacca was a wise, sophisticated being of great strength and loyalty. As technologically savvy as the brightest Academy graduate, he was also a skilled [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]]. Chewbacca, like many Wookiees, was able to understand [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], but he could not speak it due to his [[Species/Legends|species's]] vocal structure. He instead spoke [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]], the main [[Wookiee language]], composed largely of growls and grunts, to his non-Wookiee companions who typically replied in Basic.

==Biography==
===Early life (200 BBY to 19 BBY)===
====Childhood====
{{Quote|Oh, he was a sight to behold! Such strength, such skill, such fury&mdash;such grace!|Malla to Threepio and Artoo|translated=1|<ref name="SW-Chew">[[Star Wars: Chewbacca (2000)|''Star Wars: Chewbacca'' (2000)]]</ref>}}
[[File:Chewbacca_004.jpg|thumb|left|210px|A young Chewbacca on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]]]
Chewbacca was born on Kashyyyk in [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]],<ref name="chewie-db">{{DB|character|chewbacca|Chewbacca}}</ref><ref name="The Lost City of the Jedi" /><ref name="TMOSW" /> the [[Parent/Legends|son]] of [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]]. During his early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] Chewbacca lived on Kashyyyk, but unlike many other Wookiees who rarely left the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] lush [[Tree/Legends|forests]], Chewbacca was consumed by an overpowering sense of adventure and exploration. Chewbacca's first travels were to the remote and dangerous lower levels of Kashyyyk's immense forests, the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]]. The Wookiee spent his first fifty years learning to participate in Wookiee society and gaining wisdom from his father. It was not long before his travels took him far from the confines of his green homeworld. In [[150 BBY/Legends|150 BBY]], at the age of fifty, Chewbacca left Kashyyyk to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in a rite of passage known as "[[The Rising Path]]." Chewbacca experienced a variety of adventures across different planets, eventually adopting a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]] and a [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] as a deterrent to the many beings who often sought to test his strength.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:ChewbaccaVSTojjevvuk.png|thumb|right|250px|Chewbacca was challenged to a fight by [[Tojjevvuk]] for [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]]'s affections]]
In his younger days, before he had reached 100 years of age, Chewbacca was well known for his skill at navigating the tall [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] and his skill with a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]]. Chewbacca spent some time repairing vehicles with his friends, including the Wookiee [[Dryanta]]. When Chewbacca first met his future wife Mallatobuck, he was unaware of the young Wookiee's feelings toward him. Malla was shy and hid all hints of her true feelings, even going so far as to not show appreciation when Chewbacca once saved her from [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. However, Chewbacca's cousin [[Jowdrrl]] was friends with Malla and helped to slowly create a relationship between the two. Their blossoming relationship hit a snag when the Wookiee [[Tojjevvuk]] began to fight for Malla's affection. Chewbacca was eventually forced into an honor duel with Tojjevvuk for Malla's hand, but Tojjevvuk brought dishonor on the duel by [[Madclaw|using his claws]], forbidden for a Wookiee. However, Chewbacca's expertise in navigating the wroshyr trees proved to be Tojjevvuk's downfall, and a timed tackle by Chewbacca sent Tojjevvuk into a plummet into the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]], where he was killed by the dangerous creatures of Kashyyyk.<ref name="SW-Chew" />

At some point in his early adulthood, Chewbacca became a member of the [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac Guild]], a secretive organization of Wookiee [[Navigator/Legends|navigators]] and [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. Based out of [[Tree Vikkilynn/Legends|Tree Vikkilynn]] in the Kashyyyk city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], the Claatuvac Guild was responsible for charting new [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Chewbacca had become one of the Guild's most trusted navigators.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Chewbacca lived with his family in [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]], and with his father was responsible for the creation of many villages on Kashyyyk in the decades before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

====Alaris Prime====
{{Quote|I have taught all that I can. He is ready to take his place in the galaxy.|Qui-Gon Jinn after the Battle for Alaris Prime|audio=ChewbaccaReady.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
=====Helping his father=====
{{Quote|An unexplored world is a hostile world. I must help the Wookiee leader Attichitcuk to learn the lay of the land. Only then can we find an appropriate place to settle.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=HelpingAttichitcuk.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Chewie_and_Shoran.png|thumb|right|210px|Chewbacca and Shoran were among the first Wookiees to explore Alaris Prime.]]
Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] Attichitcuk led a group of Wookiees to [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovered]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]], another planet in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. Chewbacca joined his father and<ref name="GB" /> cousin<ref name="TT" /> [[Shoran]] along with many other Wookiees in a journey on the ''[[Thalmussen]]'' and three other transport ships through the [[Alaris Expanse]] to reach Alaris Prime. Attichitcuk disembarked on the moon first and explored part of it, establishing a [[Attichitcuk's camp|camp]] and leaving [[marker]]s on the path to it. Shoran left next, leaving behind his own markers..<ref name="GB" />

Chewbacca left the tranports next and was guided in his exploration by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had been appointed by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to aid the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]]. Chewbacca followed Shoran and Attichitcuk's markers until he met Shoran at the site of a damaged [[Power core/Legends|power core]]. The core had been built by the company known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], who were making an [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegal]] effort to colonize Alaris Prime and had arrived prior to the Wookiees. The core had been damaged by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a hostile predator species, and then abandoned. Jinn advised destroying the core, which Chewbacca and Shoran did by shooting at it with their [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]]. The two Wookiees made their way to Attichitcuk's camp, which they quickly had to [[Attack on Attichitcuk's camp|defend]] from four gundarks with Attichitcuk's help.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Gundark_nest.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chewbacca and the colonists fighting battle droids at the gundark nest]]
After surviving the first hostility on Alaris Prime the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]] of of the moon began in earnest. Chewbacca arrived at a Wookiee [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|command center]] where Jinn was instructing a group of five Wookiee workers on techniques for gathering resources. His arrival proved to be timely as four gundarks began to [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|attack]] the [[command center]], the Wookiee workers retreated into the building and used its [[Turret/Legends|turret]] to fire on the gundarks, while Chewbacca helped defend the center with his bowcaster. The gundark attacks prompted Jinn to propose a permanent solution, to find and [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|destroy]] the [[Unidentified gundark nest|gundark nest]].<ref name="GB" />

At one of the Wookiee [[Unidentified Wookiee base (gundark attack)|bases]] Chewbacca and Jinn trained Wookiees as [[bowcaster trooper]]s while also gathering resources. Chewbacca helped find [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] to store in an [[animal nursery]] for continual [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] production.<ref name="GB" /> Once at least ten<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> troopers were sufficiently trained Chewbacca marched along with them to the site of the gundark nest, [[Death/Legends|killing]] two gundarks on the way there. At the nest the Wookiees discovered Trade Federation [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] already exterminating the gundarks. With the creatures all dead the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] turned their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] on the Wookiees,<ref name="GB" /> seeing them as enemies just like the gundarks,<ref name="Prima" /> but Chewbacca and the Wookiees fought back and destroyed all the droids.<ref name="GB" />

=====Leadership=====
{{Quote|Battlefield promotions are not easy to deal with, but Chewbacca handles the leadership role with a skill not often seen.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=KingChewie.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Wounded_Itchy_SWGB.png|thumb|right|200px|Chewbacca rescued his father after a Trade Federation ambush.]]
Now aware of a far more dangerous enemy on Alaris Prime than the gundarks, the Wookiee colonists began preparing for war. Attichitcuk led a small scouting expedition to uncover the extent of the Federation's presence and was [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|gunned down]] by a group of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] commanded by [[DRN-38]] on his return trip to the [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]] where Chewbacca waited. Jinn sensed the ambush through [[The Force/Legends|the force]] but assured Chewbacca that his father had survived. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] instructed the Wookiees to build a [[Unidentified Wookiee medical droid|medical droid]] and train<ref name="GB" /> at least ten<ref name="Prima" /> bowcaster troopers to attempt a [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescue]] of the [[Wookiee Chieftain|chieftain]].<ref name="GB" />

Moving out from the base the Wookiees destroyed three B1 battle droids near a [[Water/Legends|river]] as well as another four on the other side. Further along the forest path they found Attichitcuk near death. Chewbacca stood over his father while the medical droid resuscitated him enough to make the trip to the base safely. On the march back the Wookiees defeated six battle droids that awaited them<ref name="GB" /> with the help of a small group of Wookiee reinforcements who had followed the party's trail.<ref name="Prima" /> At the base Attichitcuk took safety in its command center while Chewbacca and the others dealt with a surprise attack by three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. With his father needing time to fully heal Chewbacca became the leader of the colonists, in that capacity he and Jinn began their concrete efforts to remove the Trade Federation from Alaris Prime permanently.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Alaris_Prime_colonists.png|thumb|left|200px|Chewbacca on Alaris Prime]]
Chewbacca decided to target Trade Federation bases to make the corporation rethink their commitment to the moon, first choosing an [[Trade Federation outpost|outpost]] where B1 battle droids were produced. Chewbacca commanded a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (shipyard)|base]] near the rough location of the outpost and oversaw resource gathering and the training of more soldiers. The Wookiees used [[HummBike]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeders]] to explore the area surrounding the base and found no trace of the outpost, leading Jinn to assume it was located on the other side of the nearby river. After the bike-riding [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] crossed the water and located the base Chewbacca<ref name="GB" /> and fifteen other<ref name="Prima" /> Wookiees boarded [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcrafts]] and followed where the scouts had gone. They then made their way to the outpost and [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|destroyed]] it along with its five battle droid guards.<ref name="GB" />

Chewbacca established one [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] near another [[Shoran's camp|settlement]] run by Shoran, where they began trading resources using [[Corellian HoverFreighter]]s while Jinn lectured on the benefits of having allies. Shoran found a Jedi [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]] within his camp, and to prevent it from falling into enemy hands Jinn had Chewbacca's workers build a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|Jedi temple]] in his camp, allowing Jinn's Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to arrive. While Kenobi left to retrieve the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] Shoran spotted a strike force of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]] and [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s commanded by [[LUH-989]] headed towards Chewbacca's camp. Jinn warned Chewbacca to garrison his workers for their safety and prepare his warriors, which included bowcaster and [[dragon trooper]]s, to stand guard at the edge of the camp.<ref name="GB" />

=====Final attacks=====
{{Quote|You've won the day again! Chewbacca's strategies are bearing fruit.|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees after the attack on the Trade Federation listening array|audio=VictoryArray.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Attack_on_the_listening_array.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Chewbacca led further attacks on Trade Federation bases.]]
Chewbacca's Wookiees were able to [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|repel]] the invaders, and at Shoran's request Chewbacca donated 100 [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] to him to aid in recovery from the attack. Kenobi later returned with the holocron and stored it in the Jedi temple, after which Shoran's scouts uncovered a Trade Federation [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]], also run by LUH-989.<ref name="GB" /> Chewbacca rallied a force of between 8 and 30 Wookiees<ref name="Prima" /> and marched through Shoran's camp to reach the listening array, destroying all the droids and [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] there. Following the attack Chewbacca began planning the final assault on the Trade Federation, aiming to destroy a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] in their last [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]].<ref name="GB" />

Chewbacca and Shoran gathered at another [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]], where Shoran had partially completed the initial defensive walls. Chewbacca had his workers begin filling in the gaps and fortifying the base. Attichitcuk had made a full recovery from his injuries and was healthy enough to take up arms. Jinn also requested permission from the Jedi Council to personally aid the Wookiees, which was granted on the condition that they build their own fortress. The Wookiees had to gather enough resources to upgrade their technology level again, after which they could complete the fortress. Once Jinn arrived Chewbacca and the Wookiee forces, which included Shoran, Attichitcuk,<ref name="GB" /> ten [[Agr (starfighter)|Agr]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] three [[Blade bomber|Heavy Blade]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]], three [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], five [[Kas tank]]s, and five heavy bowcaster troopers headed for the Trade Federation base.<ref name="Prima" />

The bombers and fighters cleared out the base's buildings and turrets, allowing Chewbacca and the infantry and mechs to safely march in. The Trade Federation fortress was equipped with anti-air weaponry, so the Wookiees used the energy pummels to raze it.<ref name="Prima" /> With the fortress destroyed the Trade Federation was removed from Alaris Prime. Jinn praised Chewbacca's leadership abilities, acknowledging that he was ready to take his place in the galaxy.<ref name="GB" />

====Clone Wars====
{{Quote|Good-bye, Tarfful. Good-bye, Chewbacca. Miss you, I will.|Yoda|audio=Yoda-MissYouIWill.flac|<ref name="Rots" />}}
[[File:Chewie-TCW.png|thumb|right|150px|Chewbacca during the Clone Wars]]
For all of Chewbacca's success, rivalries between different Wookiee families continued to plague [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Tvrrdko]], the father of Tojjevvuk continued to seek revenge for the death of his son, but waited for the ideal moment. Tvrrdko's wrath had caused Chewbacca to stay away from his homeworld, but the Confederate threat to Kashyyyk forced him to return. The clones and their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] recruited many of the Wookiees, and Chewbacca became a leading member of the Wookiee resistance to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

During the first year of the Clone Wars, Chewbacca was considered to be one of the Wookiee King [[Grakchawwaa/Legends|Grakchawwaa's]] greatest warriors. He led the Jedi to the traitor [[Quaagan]], who was conspiring with Confederate commander [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

Chewbacca was captured by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] trophy hunters sometime during the second year of the Clone Wars, only days after [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was captured by the same Trandoshans. The purpose of this capture was to serve as prey in a trophy hunt. Chewbacca was taken to the Trandoshan moon of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], where he was to be hunted by the Trandoshans. After Ahsoka and her fellow Jedi [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] destroyed the prisoner transport vessel, he escaped and joined them. Using his technical expertise and parts from the crashed transport, he constructed a transmitter to contact his fellow Wookiees, which eventually allowed all those trapped on the [[Island Four/Legends|Trandoshan hunting island]] to escape after they defeated the hunters in their [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|fortress]].<ref name="Wookiee Hunt">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>

Chewbacca was a major player in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], overseeing the confrontation between the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]] and the invading droid forces at [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] alongside [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="chewie-db" /> It was Chewbacca, along with Tarfful, who accompanied Jedi General [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] in the charge against the enemy. Chewbacca had greater incentive than most Wookiees to assist in the defense of Kachirho: an objective of the Separatist invasion was to seize the information on secret hyperspace routes rumored to be held in the Claatuvac Guild's vaults.<ref name="Atlas" />

Following the implementation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Chewbacca helped Yoda elude the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and escape from the planet.<ref name="chewie-db" /> The execution of their Jedi officers by the clones made the nature of the newly declared [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] clear to the Wookiees, and Claatuvac Guildmaster [[Gumbaeki]] refused to surrender the Guild's records to it. Chewbacca was one of perhaps a dozen Wookiees, the Guild's most trusted scouts and navigators, who was entrusted with a [[HoloGrid/Legends|HoloGrid]] that stored the Guild's information on hyperspace routes. Guildmaster Gumbaeki then destroyed the information in the Claatuvac vault and assisted in the defense of the city while Chewbacca and his compatriots stole away. Chewbacca hid his HoloGrid in a location known only to him, and it would not come to light again until many years afterwards.<ref name="Atlas" />

====Post Clone Wars====
[[File:Wookieegoodbye.png|thumb|left|250px|Yoda bids farewell to Chewbacca (right) and [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] (left) after surviving [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].]]
With the battle concluded, Chewbacca was attacked by [[Hronk]], a relative of [[Tojjevvuk]] seeking vengeance. The arrival of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] broke the fight up, leaving the conflict to be resolved later.

Two months after the Battle of Kashyyyk, Chewbacca was called upon by a former trader and Wookiee representative, [[Cudgel (Human)|Cudgel]], to aid a small band of renegade Jedi led by [[Olee Starstone]] in their search for any other survivors after Order 66. The rescue operation proved unsuccessful, however, as the Empire tracked the fleeing Jedi to Kashyyyk and began their assault to capture them. The Wookiees, still haunted by the aftermath from their battle with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] only a month before, resumed fighting to defend their homes from the Imperial onslaught. The tide turned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] with the unexpected arrival of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], now known as Darth Vader, who wasted no time in slaughtering whatever stood between himself and the missing Jedi.

Vader ordered one of the orbiting Star Destroyers to bombard Kashyyyk with repetitive turbolaser fire, laying waste to the surrounding cities while he searched for the remaining fugitives. In an attempt to help his comrades escape, [[Roan Shryne]], one of the remaining Jedi who had earlier encountered Vader during the execution of Order 66, faced off with Vader alone while the others attempted to flee. Chewbacca assisted in the escape of Olee, a small group of smugglers, and several of those wounded in battle. After the fall and enslavement of Kashyyyk to the Galactic Empire, Chewbacca resolved to become a crew member aboard the ''[[Drunk Dancer]]'' along with Olee, and aided his new-found friends in sabotaging the Empire's efforts at any given opportunity, claiming he would be "more helpful to Kashyyyk as a fugitive, not a captive."

Now wanted, Chewbacca wandered the galaxy, managing to evade the slave traders. One day, Chewbacca came across a wounded [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] named [[Mala Mala]] and carried her to the sick bay of a ship, where she received life-saving medical attention from a medical droid. After seeing that she was all right, the two parted ways, only to see each other years later. During his travels, Chewbacca gained many friends and even owned a ship of his own.

===Life under the Empire (19 BBY to 4 ABY)===
====Meeting Han Solo====
{{Quote|You will pay for this lieutenant. '''Both''' of you will!|[[Pter Nyklas]] to Han Solo and Chewbacca|<ref name="Chewbacca2">[[Chewbacca (2000) 2|''Chewbacca'' (2000) 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:WookieeRevolt-Chewbacca2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Chewbacca leads a Wookiee slave revolt against Ssoh.]]
However, even the mighty Chewbacca was not immune to failures, and he soon became another captive of Trandoshan slavers. Tvrrdko, still bitter over his son's death, betrayed Chewbacca and sold him to the Trandoshan slaver [[Ssoh]]. Ssoh had devised a method of transporting Wookiees safely without fear of them escaping. The Trandoshan made sure to mix different Wookiee clans in the holding cells so that their vendettas would keep each other from escaping. When Chewbacca was thrown in Ssoh's holding cell, several Wookiee families including the [[Puurrgerr]], [[Grrobahrr]], and [[Chevappa]] clans immediately began to question his allegiances. Chewbacca had become disgusted with the Wookiee rivalries and how they had kept the Wookiees trapped in slavery. In an impassioned speech, Chewbacca convinced the other Wookiees that it was better to die a free Wookiee than be concerned about honor as a slave. With help from the now allied Wookiees, Chewbacca fashioned a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]], cut open their prison, and took over the ship. Ssoh became the only Trandoshan to live after a hand-to-hand battle with Chewbacca after the enraged Wookiee ripped his arms and his legs out of their sockets.<ref name="SW-Chew" />

[[File:Han_saves_Chewbacca.jpg|thumb|left|180px|right|Solo stuns Nyklas to save Chewbacca.]]
Following this turn of events, Chewbacca often attempted freeing Wookiees slaves who had been captured by either the Empire or Trandoshan slavers. On one such endeavor, he became involved in a botched slave transfer between a Trandoshan crew and an Imperial commander, [[Pter Nyklas]]. Chewbacca orchestrated the escape of close to all of the slaves which consisted mostly of Wookiee children, but in the process had his ship [[Skirmish near Komnor|come under fire]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] led by Lieutenant Han Solo. Nyklas was infuriated at the loss of the Wookiee slaves and ordered Solo to kill the Wookiee (who had been rendered unconscious by the firefight). Solo refused, inciting Nyklas's fury, but the commander eventually calmed enough to realize Chewbacca's value as a slave. The Wookiee children happened to be members of Tvrrdko's clan, and the Wookiee leader ended up canceling the feud between their two families. Nyklas worked Chewbacca unmercifully, taking great pleasure in whipping the demoralized Wookiee. However, Nyklas did not count on any more interventions by Solo, and the young lieutenant saved Chewbacca from being whipped to death. The two escaped from Imperial influence with a small bounty on their heads, and Solo was drummed out of Imperial service.

Due to Chewbacca's heroic efforts to save the children, several of whom were of Tvrrdko's clan, Tvrrdko called off the vendetta, something unheard of in Wookiee history.

====Smuggler====
Though Solo initially resented Chewbacca for his dismissal from the Imperial Military, he eventually became the Corellian's close companion as a smuggler. "Chewie," as Solo affectionately called him, stood by Solo until his death, partly out of friendship, and partly as a result of his [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to him. Chewbacca even entrusted his [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac]] [[HoloGrid/Legends|HoloGrid]] to Solo, and the two of them used the information on routes contained within to make smuggling runs in record time.<ref name="Atlas" />

Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Chewbacca accompanied Han Solo to the [[Mondder Spaceport]] on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. He and Solo ran into [[Jahan Cross]] while fleeing a gang of angry gamblers. As the brawl broke out, Chewbacca grabbed a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] by the ankles, swung him around and tossed him over a wall. The [[Security Police/Legends|Espos]] arrived and rounded everyone up but Chewbacca and Solo were spared from arrest by the intervention of Cross. After the situation was cleared up, Solo and Chewbacca returned to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to retrieve their lost [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], despite the Wookiee's apprehension.<ref name="AotE:IE1">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref>

Later that evening, Chewbacca and Solo were confronted on their ship by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Myrsk]] who was looking for Cross. When the sergeant punched Solo for making an insolent comment, Chewbacca took offense and had to be restrained from attacking the Espo. Solo suggested Myrsk apologize to the Wookiee or else there might be violence. After the Espos left, Cross emerged from a smuggling compartment and discussed his plans with Solo. Once the Imperial agent left, Chewbacca wondered if Cross would treat the pair fairly. Solo assured him that Cross was honorable and would pay his debts.<ref name="AotE:IE3">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 3|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 3]]</ref>

Chewbacca was present when Cross and [[Elli Stark]] boarded the ''Millennium Falcon'' and helped pilot the ship to Reltooine. He remarked that Elli was attractive, and Solo responded that she was too high maintenance and preferred a smuggler girl. When Chewbacca brought up [[Salla Zend]], Solo stated that he wasn't the marrying kind. Once they reached Reltooine, they were attacked by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class starfighters]]. Chewbacca help Solo pilot the freighter as they fought off their attackers.<ref name="AotE:IE4">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 4|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 4]]</ref> He was piloting the freighter when Elli Stark called to be picked up from the Eclipse. After retrieving Cross and Stark from the falling space station, Chewbacca returned to Etti IV on the ''Millennium Falcon''. He expressed disbelief that Solo wanted to use the credits they earned from Cross to play sabacc.<ref name="AotE:IE5">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 5|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 5]]</ref>

[[File:Little_Kessel.png|thumb|right|200px|Han Solo and Chewbacca set a new record for the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]].]]
Bonded to Solo, Chewbacca accompanied him on several misadventures. On one such, the Wookiee was captured and taken to [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]], a hidden [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] prison, where he was quickly rescued. The years went on as Chewbacca accompanied Solo on treasure hunts and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] runs. After Solo won the ''Millennium Falcon'', the first trip was back to Kashyyyk, where Chewbacca ultimately [[Wedding of Chewbacca and Mallatobuck|married]] Mallatobuck and fathered a son named [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]]. Another run was notable because, in the ''Millennium Falcon'', the two made the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]] in less than twelve parsecs. The next attempt was less successful, resulting in the dumping of a spice shipment due to pursuing Imperials. On this same mission Chewbacca became reunited with Hronk, who had become an Imperial slave on [[Formos/Legends|Formos]]. In spite of the fact that Tojjevvuk's father had called off the feud years ago, Hronk still held a grudge against Chewbacca. Chewbacca's attitude towards honor duels had changed, however, and he ended up saving the Wookiee from captivity, earning forgiveness from the last holdout of a once hostile clan. Unfortunately, this was the only thing that went right, as the undelivered shipment landed Han with a heavy bounty on his head placed by the notorious [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], the crime lord who owned the shipment.

After a string of unsuccessful smuggling ventures in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], Chewbacca and Han left the sector as they soon realized they weren't cut out for legitimate work. Nearly broke, the two accepted a job carrying valuable cargo for ten thousand credits. Unfortunately, the cargo turned out to be slaves, in which the Corporate Sector was suspected of being involved. Receiving help from [[BLX-5|Bollux]] and [[Blue Max]], Chewbacca and Han managed to track down the recipients of the cargo. Shortly afterwards, Chewbacca and Han again found themselves on the brink of being broke. Chewbacca along with Bollux and Blue Max accompanied Han to the university world of [[Rudrig/Legends|Rudrig]] to locate the lost treasure of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]]. On Rudig, Chewbacca and Han struck a deal with master gunman [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]]. Though they found the treasure, Solo realized that there would be boobytraps and warned Gallandro, who believed that Solo and Chewbacca wanted to cut him out of his share. Solo dueled the deluded Gallandro to prevent him from continuing, but was wounded and could only watch helplessly as Gallandro was killed by hidden security blasters. Little did they know Chewbacca and Han would encounter his daughter, [[Anja Gallandro]], nearly two decades later.

[[File:Boost_hanchewie.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Han Solo and Chewbacca in the heat of the action]]
Following their near-death experience on Rudrig, Chewbacca returned home, where he led several Wookiees to a Wookiee safe house where they would be safe from traders. However, the bounty hunter [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] showed up and attempted to enslave Chewbacca and the others. Just before Bossk could capture the entire group, Han Solo returned and destroyed Bossk's ship by landing on it in the ''Millennium Falcon'', leaving the bounty hunter stranded. The act earned Bossk's enmity of the both of them.

At some point during this time, Chewbacca was also involved with a [[Skirmish on Kashyyyk (Galactic Civil War)|run-in]] with several scout troopers on the planet. He was eventually shot off of his Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft by a trooper on a speeder bike, slamming onto a ''[[StarSpeeder 1000]]'' that had been behind them (the vessel having earlier escaped from an Imperial [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid]] that occurred at [[Spaceport THX1138]]). He attempted to climb up but ultimately fell off.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

That very same year, Chewbacca and Han were contacted by Jabba, who wanted the two to locate the priceless [[Yavin Vassilika]]. The two then entered in the race where they found themselves once again face to face with bounty hunters, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and Bossk, and the smuggler, Lando Calrissian. Chewbacca and Solo started their search in the [[Mon Calamari (language)/Legends|Mon Calamarian]] city of [[Mon Ubris]]. Pursued by Bossk and his team, their trail led them to the mysterious Bank of Knowledge. However, their search on Mon Calamari lead them to a dead end. The gem was later retrieved by the Rebel Alliance and Han's old flame, [[Bria Tharen]].

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:Chewbacca_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Chewbacca at the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]]]

====Joining the Rebellion====
{{Quote|What made you come back, Han?''"<br />"''Oh, the Wookiee here got stubborn about it.|Luke Skywalker and Han Solo, shortly before the victory ceremony following the Battle of Yavin|audio=LukeHan-StubbornWookiee.flac|<ref name="Star Wars radio">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
It was Chewbacca that Obi-Wan Kenobi spoke to in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], where Chewbacca and Han happened to be, when in search of transportation to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It is not known whether the Wookiee recognized Kenobi from their time on Alaris Prime or if Chewbacca's friendship with Yoda during the Clone Wars influenced the decision to help the Jedi. Regardless, Chewbacca introduced the aged Jedi Master and his young companion, Luke Skywalker, to Han Solo, and soon the pair bought passage on the ''Falcon''. During the flight over to Alderaan, Chewbacca also played some [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]] with the droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], although he ended up losing, to his frustration. After learning from Han that Wookiees like Chewbacca were known to rip people's arms out of their sockets, 3PO suggested to R2 to "let the Wookiee win."

Once they reached Alderaan, they discovered that the planet had been blown to bits by the Empire. While trying to stop a TIE fighter from revealing their presence in the system, Chewbacca and the others were hauled into the Death Star by its tractor beams. The group managed to evade the Imperial officers by hiding in a secret compartment in the ''Falcon''. After the discovery of Princess Leia's presence on the station, Luke convinced Solo and Chewbacca to help him rescue the princess. Luke formulated a plan, which involved Han and Luke impersonating as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] while Chewbacca pretended to be their prisoner. However, Chewbacca, believing that Luke was actually trying to sell him out, snarled at him when Luke attempted to cuff him, forcing Luke to let Han cuff him, with the latter reassuring Chewbacca that he suspects he knows what Luke was actually planning. While Obi-Wan set off to disable the tractor beams, Chewbacca, Han, and Luke managed to rescue Leia, defeating several Imperial officers in the process. Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] initially disliked Chewbacca as much as she disdained Han and called him a "walking carpet," but the friendship between the two grew over time. Though their mission was successful, Obi-Wan wasn't so lucky, as he was killed by Darth Vader in a lightsaber duel. Chewbacca, Han, Luke and Leia managed to escape the space station.

Chewbacca accompanied the others to the Rebel base of Yavin 4 where they were preparing for their strike at the Death Star. Eager to get their pay, Solo and the Wookiee chose not to get involved with their "revolution" and left. However, Chewbacca managed to convince Han to return and help the Rebels. Han finally gave in, helping Luke Skywalker destroy the Death Star. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin 4, Chewbacca, Han, and Luke received medals for their heroism during the battle.

====Hero of the Rebel Alliance====
[[File:Chewie_medal.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chewbacca receives a medal for his heroic efforts during the Battle of Yavin.]]
Having retrieved the reward money for Han's bounty, Chewbacca and Han set off to pay Jabba. However, the money was stolen by the pirate, [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]]. With the help of Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia, Chewbacca and Han managed to defeat the pirate. Following the debacle, Solo gave the recovered money back to the Alliance. Broke and fearing Jabba's retribution, Solo and Chewbacca discovered an ancient cache of treasure hidden in one of Yavin IV's temples. He and Han stole the treasure, against Chewbacca's wishes.

Solo and Chewbacca were later tasked with finding a power gem as their means to destroy the ''Executor'' by Princess Leia. Their first stop was to [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]]. Chewbacca discovered from a local barfly (an agent of Mystra) a potential lead of where a power gem might be found; in Raskar's possession on Antipose. However, because of his attempting to learn directions from the barfly, he was distracted from saving Solo from would-be assassins that were hired by Jabba the Hutt, eventually realizing and saving Solo at the last second by picking the two up and throwing them out of the catana. He then supplied the lead to an irate Solo. Eventually, they discovered that the lead was genuine, and Solo arranged for Chewbacca to fight in Solo's place, to Chewbacca's initial anger. However, Solo planned to have Chewbacca fight the primary candidate for the gem outside of the arena in an all-out brawl as a means to distract Mystra and Raskar while he got into the power gem area, analyze the extent of its power, and then steal or otherwise negotiate getting it. Eventually, he got tired out, although unfortunately for the reigning champion, that only made Chewbacca more ferocious. Eventually, they managed to gain the power gem in exchange for keeping quiet to the Antipose contestants about the weakened state of the power gem, although Solo later admitted to Chewbacca that he plans to return later to loot Raskar of his ill-gotten gains as Raskar's punishment for his scam operation.<ref name="tpg">"[[The Power Gem]]"</ref>

Several months after the Battle of Yavin, the two assisted [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], an elite Rebel fighting force created by Han prior to Yavin, during the [[Battle of the Graveyard]]. In the ''Millennium Falcon'', Chewbacca and Han scanned for a holocron with a vital list of possible bases for the Alliance. (The holocron, created by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], was encased in [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]] and survived the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]]). The holocron was found; however, the ''Millennium Falcon'' was damaged by [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] during the battle. Renegade Squadron was forced to retrieve the holocron. In order to repair the ''Millennium Falcon'', Chewbacca, Han, and the squadron rendezvoused on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. However, they were discovered by [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]], the droid bounty hunter, and a [[Skirmish on Ord Mantell (0.5 ABY)|skirmish]] with Imperials ensued. Chewbacca searched for parts for the ''Millennium Falcon'' in the huge junkyards near the hangar while protected by Renegade Squadron, and, after finding them, assisted the squadron in protecting Han while the smuggler made the repairs to his ship. After completing them (all the while fighting off stormtroopers and even IG-88), Han, Chewbacca, and Renegade Squadron lifted off, barely escaping the clutches of a Star Destroyer squadron. Only several days later, he and Han helped prepare the evacuation craft that allowed Ackbar and Renegade Squadron to escape [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]].

A year after the Battle of Yavin, Chewbacca and Han returned to Tatooine where they caught up with Luke in the Mos Eisley cantina. After fleeing from Imperial stormtroopers, Chewbacca, Han, Luke and the droids were stranded in the Dune Sea of Tatooine. In order to escape, they arranged a deal with some Jawas to travel with them in their sandcrawler. Shortly afterwards they learned of the House of Tagge, which was working in concert with the Empire to create a long range freezing mechanism. The Rebels eluded their Imperial pursuers and headed back to Mos Eisley.

Shortly before Life Day, Chewbacca returned to duty in the Rebel Alliance. While on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Solo and Chewbacca discovered an unauthorized transmission emanating from the jungle around the [[Great Temple|Massassi base]]. They eventually found an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spy amongst the Rebels and successfully stopped him. A short while after, Chewbacca and Han left for the celebration of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] on Kashyyyk. It served as a ''short'' break between the periodical fighting. But peace didn't last long for the pair. Not long after they departed Tatooine for Kashyyyk, they found themselves once again being chased by the Empire. Fleeing to lightspeed, they went on their way. However, the Empire had apparently traced their route to Kashyyyk, which they rightfully suspected to be a harbor for Rebels. Upon learning of this, Darth Vader ordered a blockade and search of the planet. A group of Imperial officers entered Chewbacca's home, terrorizing his family and wrecking the house. They looked for any sign of Rebel activity. However, after a while, Chewbacca's son, who then went by the name Lumpawarrump, devised a plan. He used his [[mini-transmitter]], which he had received as a Life Day present from [[Saun Dann]], to send out a voice message through the Imperial airwaves&mdash;which changed the sound of Lumpy's voice. He gave the command of "return to base," which the officers in the home picked up on their receivers. They complied, with the exception of the stormtrooper known as [[B4711]], who was ordered by a superior to stay behind in order to temporarily watch the house for Rebel activity. However, the trooper soon learned of Lumpy's trick, and pursued him through the house, out onto the balcony, where Han and Chewbacca had just arrived. Chewbacca roared as Han managed to kill the trooper. That night, the group, along with the other Wookiees on Kashyyyk, celebrated an uninterrupted Life Day.

[[File:SWEMP22-FC.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Chewbacca and Han run into trouble while searching for the source of the distress signal]]
Now out on their own, Chewbacca and Han went on several missions in the early years of the war. Chewbacca and Han were later hired by Ramiz, a moisture farmer on Aduba-3, to protect his village from a band of local thugs known as the [[Cloud-Riders/Legends|Cloud-Riders]] led by [[Serji-X Arrogantus]]. To aid them in their task, Chewbacca and Han hired six misfit spacers which consisted of [[Don-Wan Kihotay]], an old man who believed himself to be a Jedi Knight, [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] a rabbit-like creature, [[Hedji]], [[Amaiza Foxtrain/Legends|Amaiza Foxtrain]], young boy named [[Jimm Doshun]] and his droid [[FE-9Q]]. Arriving to at Ramiz's village Onacra, Chewbacca and the gang encountered flying High-hounds. They managed to drive away the beasts, saving the life of a young girl named Merri to the great relief of her father Oncho, the village spokesman. But their relief was short-lived once Serji-X Arrogantus and his gang [[Battle of Aduba-3|attacked]]. Chewbacca and the Star-Hoppers did their best to defend the village but it was to no avail as FE-9Q was killed and Merri's grandfather the Old One, dismissed the hired spacers' help. Instead of relying on Chewbacca and his team, the shaman summoned a large, mythical reptilian monster called the Behemoth from the World Below to handle the invading Cloud-Riders. Many members of the Star-Hoppers died trying to destroy the creature. Due to their teamwork, Chewbacca and the team were able to defeat the beast.

Approximately six months after the destruction of the Death Star, the Rebel base received a distress call from a [[Nameless planet (distress signal)|small dark planet]]. Chewbacca, Han, Princess Leia, and [[Deena Shan]] were dispatched to the planet. After an untimely detour on the dangerous planet, Chewbacca and Han were confronted by several creatures native to the planet. In addition to that they were able to uncover secrets relating to the Clone Wars. Fortunately, Chewbacca and Solo were rescued by Deena and Leia.

Once the Rebels were spread out across the galaxy, Admiral Ackbar sent Chewbacca and Han to [[Void Station]] where they encountered bounty hunter, [[Sheel Odala]]. Unfortunately, Chewbacca and Han became separated from each other when [[Jib Kopatha]]'s thugs followed Sheel, capturing Solo. Chewbacca managed to stop Odala from reaching her ship and the two were forced together in order to free him. Together, Chewbacca and Sheel managed to free Solo.

{{Talesstart}}
On another occasion, Chewbacca and Han came into the possession of some valuable glowing [[Tandgor gem]]s that Solo claimed would pay off debts and mod the ''Millennium Falcon''. They stopped on an unknown planet to get fuel. After landing on the planet, Solo and Chewbacca encountered several groaning skeletal figures&mdash;the undead. Chewbacca was able to fight them off and made a hasty retreat back to the ''Falcon'', only to find the fuel line has been severed by someone. Arming themselves, the two-man crew of the ''Falcon'' headed back and came face to face with a local and her baby, who explained to the two that the crew of a "[[Great Interplanetary Ark]]" perished after their ship crashed in the planet's fog. They were compelled to wander the planet as corpses, terrorizing the locals every night.

[[File:BattleOfThila.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chewbacca and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge]] take on several [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] during the Battle of Thila.]]
Using the Tandgor Gems to lay down lines, Han formed a makeshift runway that managed to dissolve the fog. A ghostly apparition of the ship that crashed long ago used it to land, easing the spirits of the perished crew. The living dead would no longer terrorize the planet's residents. Han and Chewbacca left the planet out of pocket, but were rewarded with enough fuel to last them the rest of their journey.
{{Talesend}}

Sometime before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] on [[Thila/Legends|Thila]], the Rebels fell under attack by the Empire. While fixing Wedge Antilles's snowspeeder, Chewbacca got himself attached to the speeder. Wedge flew off into battle with Chewbacca hanging on the bottom. Using his brute strength, the bold Wookiee managed to capture a TIE fighter then crash landed into an Imperial outpost, ending the battle. As Wedge recalled years later, he felt somewhat embarrassed but acknowledged his heroic efforts.

====Crisis on Bespin====
{{Quote|Laugh it up, fuzzball!|Han Solo, in response to Chewbacca laughing at him|audio=Fuzzball.flac|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
[[File:AbominableChewbacca-SWT.png|thumb|right|200px|Chewbacca while on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]]]
While with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the ice planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], Chewbacca was busy repairing the ''Falcon''. Meanwhile, Solo set out to recover the young Rebel, Luke Skywalker, who had gone missing during a scouting mission. Hours passed and the two didn't return. Fearing that Solo was gone, Chewbacca let out a mournful growl, hoping that he'd return. Han eventually made it back safely with Luke in tow. Unfortunately, Chewbacca was unable to finish his work due to the Imperial invasion of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], so the ''Falcon'' was forced to take off with Han Solo, Princess Leia, and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] while in disrepair. Thus, while on the run from the Imperial Fleet, the ''Falcon'' set down in an asteroid cavern for repairs.

When the cavern was discovered to be a giant [[Exogorth/Legends|slug]], the ''Falcon'' made its escape to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. On Bespin, the group met with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. When C-3PO went missing, Chewbacca set off to find the protocol droid. Chewbacca eventually found him blasted apart in a junk pile and, after a scuffle with some [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] workers, brought him back to Princess Leia and Han Solo.

However, Chewbacca did not have the time to repair C-3PO. They were all captured by Darth Vader. During their capture, Chewbacca was sealed in a room with high-pitch alarms going off, irritating the Wookiee's keen hearing.<ref name="TESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' (novel)]]</ref> C-3PO's parts were brought in, and Chewbacca began rebuilding the droid. When all but his legs were reattached with his head on backwards, Chewbacca, Leia and Han were brought to the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] freezing chamber with C-3PO hanging from a pack on Chewbacca's back. Han Solo was to be frozen as test for Luke Skywalker. Before he was frozen, Chewbacca threw several stormtroopers off the platform but was quickly cuffed. Han entrusted Chewbacca with taking care of Leia. As Chewbacca gave a loud howl, Han Solo was frozen alive, but in hibernation.

[[File:Chewie_threepio_tesb.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chewbacca and the deactivated [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]]]
While being escorted to Darth Vader's shuttle by Imperial stormtroopers, Chewbacca, Leia and Lando were freed from their captors by Bespin Security Guards led by [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]]. Released from his bindings, Chewbacca grabbed hold of Lando's throat in a vengeful rage and began to strangle him. Leia was able to get the location of Han Solo's frozen body to the East Platform. Chewbacca let go of Lando and left him gasping for breath on the floor with C-3PO apologizing for the Wookiee's behavior as Chewbacca and Leia rushed off.

However, Leia and Chewbacca arrived at the platform just as [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] made off with Han Solo. With that, a pursuit ensued in the Cloud City corridors with stormtroopers. Joined by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Leia, Lando, and Chewbacca eventually made their way back to the ''Millennium Falcon''. When escaping the city, Leia received a telepathic call for help from Luke and commanded Chewbacca to turn the ship around. After rescuing Luke, the ''Falcon'' left the planet behind. While attempting to escape the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] over Bespin, the supposed repaired [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] failed and Chewbacca was once again forced to fix it. However, R2-D2 quickly activated it and the ''Falcon'' escaped to the Rebellion rendezvous point. Chewbacca and Lando would then start their search for Boba Fett and Han Solo.

====Teaming up with Calrissian====
{{Quote|Chewie, this won't help me! Hey! Save your strength, there'll be another time! The princess&mdash;you have to take care of her! Do ya hear me, huh?|Han Solo|audio=Han-ThisWontHelpMe.flac|<ref name="Episode 5" />}}
[[File:Chewbacca19BBY-SWYBYNE.png|thumb|right|130px|Chewbacca with the bowcaster he used in the Clone Wars]]
After the disastrous mission to Cloud City and the loss of his most trusted friend, Chewbacca temporarily teamed up with Lando Calrissian, occasionally accepting missions from the Rebel Alliance. Lando's search for Solo was cut short as Leia Organa summoned them to a Rebel base on the volcanic planet of [[Golrath/Legends|Golrath]]. Once there, they were informed that Luke Skywalker had been infected with a lethal disease, "[[Crimson Forever]]," which caused victims to turn crimson, eventually killing them. After boarding an Imperial vessel and finding its crew crimson-colored and dead, Luke recovered a red-glowing stone, suspecting it to be the source of whatever killed the Imperials. Luke rushed back to the Rebel headquarters, but he was already infected. In a short time, Luke was lying comatose, his eyes turned scarlet red. Leia remembered a story Han Solo had told her about the Red Nebula that featured a pair of stones similar to the one that infected Luke. Chewbacca regaled the tale, and the group came to the conclusion that the "Crimson Forever" stone was indeed one of those Chewbacca and Han had encountered&mdash;when the two stones were separated, they were extremely lethal. Following up on the lead, Chewbacca, Lando and Leia piloted the ''Millennium Falcon'' to the Red Nebula, only to find a seemingly abandoned House of Tagge spaceship. Lando and Leia boarded the vessel while Chewbacca waited in the ''Falcon''. After a near-death encounter with [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] the group escaped, destroying the Rebel Base on Golrath.

====City of Dreams====
Shortly after the beginning their initial partnership, Chewbacca and Calrissian stumbled upon the "[[City of Dreams]]," a dimensional rift inhabited by [[Cody Sunn-Childe]], a former Rebel Alliance operative and a hero of Lando's, who gained strange powers during his travels. Unbeknownst to them, the city had a strange effect on its inhabitants as they were hypnotically enthralled by the phantasmagoric surroundings. As the two explored the city Chewbacca became spellbound and seemed to forget the search for Han in favor of the city's distractions, and roughly punched Lando for speaking ill of the city. Later, the city was attacked by an Imperial fleet led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Plikk]], who had also fallen prey to the spell. The impact caused many, Chewbacca included, to snap out of their charmed state. Chewbacca and Lando piloted the ''Millennium Falcon'' in combat against the Imperials, but the battle was cut short when Sunn-Childe, who had at first allowed his demonic manifestations to attack the Star Destroyers, made no further attempt to stop the Imperial bombardment of the city, letting the fleet utterly destroy it and all its citizens, himself included. The ''Falcon'' then escaped through the rapidly closing dimensional gate, but the Imperials&mdash;who, because of their excessive bombardment, lacked the hyperdrive power to escape&mdash;were forever trapped in Sunn-Childe's dimension.<ref name="Star Wars 46: The Dreams of Cody Sunn-Childe">[[Star Wars (1977) 46|''Star Wars'' (1977) 46]]</ref>

====Destruction of the ''Tarkin''====
[[File:Chewbacca-TCGEoD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chewbacca battling [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]]]
Informed by an operative that the Empire was constructing a new superweapon&mdash;the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']]&mdash; [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] ordered Chewbacca and Lando to stop their search for a new planet on which the Alliance could establish a new headquarters, and return to the temporary base. Once there, they were briefed on their new mission&mdash;to destroy the ''Tarkin''. A small commando team consisting of Chewbacca, Leia, Luke, C-3PO and R2-D2 infiltrated the superweapon dressed as workers, and proceeded to strike at its reactor with a proton grenade. Lando, whom both Leia and General Rieekan thought of as untrustworthy&mdash;to such a degree that he was "left out" of the mission&mdash;sneaked aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'' that the commando team piloted to Hockaleg, the planet which the ''Tarkin'' orbited. Lando hoped to make himself useful by staying with the ''Falcon'', ready to rush to the superweapon to save his friends.

Unbeknownst to the commando team, Vader was also present at the space station, having sensed that Skywalker had infiltrated it. Believing the Rebels' plan was to destroy the ''Tarkin''{{'s}} reactor, Vader personally saw to the protection of that area, delegating the rest of the security personnel to potential escape routes. However, just as he was on his way to catch Luke, a group of high-ranking Imperial officers attempted to kill the Sith by opening an airlock, sending Vader into space. The plan was foiled by Vader himself&mdash;using the Force, he was able to pull himself back into the ''Tarkin'' from the vacuum of space. This distraction helped Luke barely escape the Dark Lord. In the meantime, Leia had wired the superweapon's ion cannon to fire upon itself&mdash;something that would utterly destroy the station. The group escaped the Imperials, returning to the Rebel Base.

====Other missions====
Following the confrontation with Vader, Princess Leia went missing while on a mission to investigate Imperial activity in the [[Shiva system/Legends|Shiva system]]. Once again derailed from their search for Solo, Chewbacca, Lando and Luke embarked on their quest to locate the princess. The trio arrived just in time, helping Leia to fight Imperial forces led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar|Sk'ar]] while Calrissian participated in the aerial assault. The battle resulted in a win for the Rebels and the death of Sk'ar by Chewbacca.

Just after the Battle of Hoth, Chewbacca, Lando, and Luke Skywalker arrived on [[Bazarre]] to negotiate the sale of four disabled Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] from a weapons dealer named [[Orion Ferret]]. Ferret gave the Rebels the location of the TIE fighters, but double-crossed them when he attempted to sabotage their shuttlecraft. Lando, having never trusted Orion, left Chewbacca behind on Bazarre to keep a watch over Ferret. No sooner had the Rebels left for Patch-4 than Orion began plotting their deaths. He believed that if he were to remotely activate the shuttle's ejection seats, then Luke and Lando would die in space, and he could keep the money, his fighters and the ''Millennium Falcon''. However, he had to find a way to get Chewbacca out of the way. With the aid of his assistant [[P'Lor]], he used a gelatinous spritzer solution to imprison the Wookiee. Unfortunately for Ferret, the solution was not strong enough to contain Chewbacca, and he soon broke free. Chewbacca chased Orion Ferret all throughout the Bazarre marketplace. Ferret attempted to flee in his personal shuttlecraft, but a few well-aimed shots from Chewbacca's bowcaster rendered the ship unusable. Lando Calrissian returned to Bazarre in time to keep Chewbacca from ripping Orion's head off.

[[File:SOTE4-FC.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Chewbacca and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] disguised as the bounty hunters [[Snoova]] and [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] respectively]]
Some time after the Battle of Hoth, Chewbacca presented his [[HoloGrid/Legends|HoloGrid]] to an astonished Princess Leia. Chewbacca's information was the only legitimate source of [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac Guild]] data discovered since the Clone Wars, and the information in secret hyperspace routes was passed up to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. The Rebel Alliance issued the information on a strictly need-to-know basis, and Chewbacca's data proved one of the Alliance's most valuable tools in its fight against the Empire.<ref name="Atlas" />

On one occasion Chewbacca accompanied Luke on his search to find information on Shira Brie, Luke's former flame. During a heated space battle with Imperial forces Luke's targeting computer malfunctioned causing the boy to rely on the force to pick his targets, shooting Brie down. In order to clear his name the two began their search on [[Shalyvane]], where Shira had once told Luke that Em'liy marauders once slaughtered her people on this world. Luke and Chewbacca met the aging G'hinji inside of a cave near the capital city of Chinshassa. G'hinji told him that there had never been Human settlements on Shalyvane and that everything Shira Brie told him was a lie. The Em'liy were the only native species to the planet, and were once a thriving community until the Emperor sent a squad of Imperial TIE bombers to Chinshassa and laid waste to the capital city. G'hinji escorted Luke to a sacred site known as the Circle of Kavaan. There, Luke discovered a holographic recording of Darth Vader, revealing the true history of Shira Brie.

Traveling to [[Krake's Planet]] to find further information on [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]], the two infiltrated the Krake Data Vault, a facility built from the mass of a giant Mind Spider. Once they recorded the information, Chewbacca used the ''Falcon''{{'s}} deflector screens to destroy the military outpost.

====Rescue of Han Solo====
{{Quote|At last we have the mighty Chewbacca.|Jabba the Hutt|audio=EejahWahkeeChewbacca.flac|translated=1|<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />}}
Chewbacca took Han's order to take care of Leia very seriously. When not helping Lando with the search for Han, he served as Leia's bodyguard. When she attempted to negotiate with the criminal super-organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] for their aid in determining who had placed a bounty on Luke Skywalker, he accompanied her to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In order to get past Imperial security, he was disguised as the Wookiee bounty hunter [[Snoova]], and Leia took on the identity of [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]]. From there the two became guests of Black Sun's leader, the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. Chewbacca, already suspicious of the crime lord, was outraged when Xizor attempted to seduce Leia. Fortunately, Chewbacca was able to remove Leia from the influence of Xizor's mind-affecting pheromones. Leia distracted Xizor long enough to allow Chewbacca to escape with the information that Xizor was in fact the one behind the bounty on Skywalker.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

Chewbacca was able to meet up with Luke, and together they formed a rescue party, along with Lando and [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]]. They were able to break into Xizor's palace through the sewers and freed Leia, escaping on the ''Millennium Falcon'' and destroying Xizor's palace in the process, crippling Black Sun.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)" />

[[File:ChewieCaptive_ST.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Leia, posing as Boushh, delivers a "captive" Chewbacca to Jabba.]]

After the death of Xizor, Chewbacca once again teamed up with Lando as he, Leia, Luke and the two droids needed help in tracking down the undercover Rebel agent [[Tay Vanis]].

Having learned that Boba Fett had finally delivered Han to Jabba the Hutt, Luke hatched a plan that involved infiltrating various members of the party into Jabba's palace. Chewbacca was inserted when Leia, again posing as Boushh, took the Wookiee to Jabba as a prisoner. After [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal-detonator]]-assisted price negotiations, Chewbacca was surrendered to Jabba and placed in a dungeon cell. When Leia failed to escape after freeing Han from the carbonite, Han was placed in the same cell. The two prisoners were soon taken out of their cells&mdash;for execution. Luke's killing of the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] had so enraged Jabba that he ordered that Luke, Han, and Chewbacca be fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. However, Luke's planning allowed him to recover his lightsaber, and together with Lando, who was disguised as one of Jabba's thugs, they turned the execution into a battle. Chewbacca protected Han, who was still blind as an effect of the [[Hibernation sickness/Legends|hibernation sickness]] he had acquired while in the carbonite. In addition, when Boba Fett attempted to gun down Luke Skywalker, Chewbacca attempted to warn Han, resulting in Han accidentally knocking Boba Fett into the Sarlacc. When Lando was knocked into the Great Pit, Chewbacca anchored Han as the smuggler leaned over the side of their skiff and rescued his old friend.

====Endor====
{{Quote|Keep your distance, Chewie, but don't look like you're keeping your distance. [&hellip;] I don't know&mdash;fly casual.|Han to Chewbacca during the mission to Endor|audio=FlyCasual.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />}}
[[File:DancesWithEwoks-ROTJ.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Chewbacca celebrates the Alliance victory after the Battle of Endor.]]
After the battle was over and Jabba killed, all the heroes, with the exception of Luke, reported to the Rebel fleet over [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. There the Rebels formed a battle plan to destroy the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Only during the briefing did Chewbacca become aware that Han, now a general, had volunteered to lead the ground assault on the shield generator protecting the Death Star. Chewbacca swiftly volunteered to join his group of commandos.

On the approach to the shield bunker, the Wookiee's lack of caution got the team into trouble. Seizing a [[Unidentified tusked creature|hunk of meat]] tied to a stick, he unwittingly sprung a trap that got Han, Luke, the droids, and himself captured by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] and taken back to their [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|village]]. There, the team reunited with Leia, who had been taken to the village after becoming separated from the others. As a result of the Ewoks' belief that C-3PO was a [[God/Legends|god]], they were able to negotiate not only their freedom but the Ewoks' aid in the upcoming battle with the Empire. Leia, Luke, Han, the droids, and Chewbacca were all made members of the Ewok tribe.

During the terrestrial portion of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Chewbacca swung the tide of the battle when he and two native Ewoks hijacked an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] and turned it against the Empire, helping the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] secure their victory on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]].

===Hero of the New Republic (4 ABY to 25 ABY)===
====Founding of the New Republic====
{{Quote|Who was that big furball that ruined my coat?''"<br />"''You don't get out much, do you? That's Chewbacca, the most famous Wookiee in the Galaxy.|[[Spinda Caveel]] and [[Zan Pike]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire: Evolution">''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire: Evolution]]''</ref>}}
Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Chewbacca and Lando were taken prisoner by Imperial Moff. To get them out of this situation, Calrissian convinced the Moff to enter a bet involving Chewbacca and the ''Falcon''. Shortly afterwards, Chewbacca found himself fighting in an Imperial arena with a huge battle droid made from spare droid parts. Using his brute strength, the Wookiee managed to defeat the droid, winning the bet and allowing them to escape.

Not long after the destruction of the Second Death Star, Chewbacca and Han Solo returned to Kashyyyk to liberate the Wookiee homeworld. Chewbacca was responsible for the reconstruction of Wookiee Government tree. Later, the noble Wookiee dealt with the treacherous [[Weebacca]] and freed the slaves, including his father, imprisoned on the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]].<ref name="GB" /> Chewbacca also played a vital role in the Battle of Bakura, where he helped Solo and the others neutralize an Imperial threat on the planet of Bakura.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> The incident brought about the establishment of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]].

====Nagai-Tof War====
Shortly after the Battle of Bakura, Chewbacca, Han and Lando Calrissian were sent on several missions to bring secure attendees for the [[First Conference of Free Peoples]]. After these recruitment missions, the group decided to take a break to visit Chewbacca's family on Kashyyyk. En route to his house, Chewbacca, Han and Lando encountered a mysterious alien named [[Ozrei N'takkilomandrife|Knife]] and Chewbacca's brother-in-law, [[Vargi]]. As it turned out, Knife took Chewbacca's family as hostages and planned to sell him and the other Wookiees in a slave trade. Imprisoning Han and Lando in his home, Knife and the rogue Wookiees under his command took Chewbacca as prisoner and proceeded to the slave ship. Fortunately the Wookiee was saved by Han Solo.

[[File:BKashyyyk.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Chewbacca during the [[Skirmish on Kashyyyk (Nagai invasion)|Skirmish on Kashyyyk]]]]
While Lando and the loyal Wookiees fought off the Nagai forces and their counterparts, Chewbacca lashed out at Vargi. Realizing that Chewbacca's outburst was disrupting the loading of Wookiees onto the slave ships, Knife prepared to kill Chewbacca with a [[tehk'la blade]], but the weapon was shot out of his hand by Lando. The Wookiees overthrew their rogue counterparts just as Chewbacca overpowered Vargi, throwing him to the ground. Knife's plans of creating a slave trade on Kashyyyk were thwarted, and the rogue Wookiees, along with the Nagai forces except Knife, were captured by the Alliance. Vargi, however, was disowned by Malla.

Chewbacca and the Alliance later joined forces with the Nagai in order to defeat their enemy and rivals, the Tofs and their leader [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] Sereno. During the [[Battle of Saijo]], Chewbacca became part of the aerial assault, leading a fighter squadron along with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]]. The battle resulted in a win for the Alliance and the surrender of Sereno, ending the [[Nagai–Tof War]].

====Later missions====
After Han's marriage to Leia Organa in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Chewbacca and his son Lumpawarrump encountered trouble on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While on Coruscant, Chewbacca pursued his son through the undercity of Coruscant after he caught burglars stealing a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] from Han and Leia. Lumpawarrump became captured and in the process of saving him, Malla was also captured. Shortly afterwards, Chewbacca and Lumpawarrump discovered that the burglars were planning to assassinate the New Republic's leaders. Determined to stop them, Chewbacca and his son infiltrated the enemies' base to find an advanced IT-3 interrogation droid attempting to brainwash Malla into believing that the Solos are a danger to her child. Enraged, Chewbacca attacked the burglars and freed Mallatobuck.<ref name="A Forest Apart">''[[A Forest Apart]]''</ref>

Later that year, Chewbacca accompanied Han, Leia, and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] on a mission to locate an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] moss painting&mdash;lost after the planet's destruction&mdash;that had resurfaced on the black market. It concealed a code used to communicate with New Republic agents undercover within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. As they pursued the painting they learned much about the man who became Darth Vader from [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]] and [[W. Wald|Wald]], childhood friends of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Fortunately, the painting was discovered and the code was destroyed.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

Chewbacca remained with Han well after his marriage to Leia. In fact, when Leia was being hunted by the mysterious [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], Chewbacca brought the former Princess to his home planet of Kashyyyk. The plan didn't hold up long, as the Noghri launched an [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Thrawn campaign)|unsuccessful attempt to abduct the princess]] there, but Leia was able to make peace with one of her assailants.<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

====Life with the Solos====
[[File:Chewie-CrystalStar.jpg|thumb|180px|Chewbacca during the [[Empire Reborn]] movement]]
Chewbacca's original life debt to Han now included Leia, her brother, and her children. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] Chewbacca participated in the offensives against Admiral Thrawn and the deranged [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], [[Joruus C'baoth]]. Along with Han, Chewbacca formed a coalition of smugglers for a last-ditch attack against the Empire, while Leia held the Alliance together and prepared for the birth of her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Solo twins|twins]]. Thrawn and his forces were defeated, and C'baoth was killed by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], a former ally of the Empire.

A year later, Chewbacca and the others discovered that the Emperor was alive and that his good friend, Luke, turned to the dark side. Fleeing to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Chewbacca, Han, and Leia, again pregnant, discovered the existence of another lethal enemy; Boba Fett. They had fled to the underworld of the Smuggler's Moon after their initial haven, the hidden repair center ran by Shug Ninx, was taken over by stormtroopers. Confronted by an array of bounty hunters, and the news that the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clans had doubled the bounty on them, they had little choice but to leave the moon&mdash;where Boba Fett had patiently waited for the ''Millennium Falcon'' to take off. Their second attempt at penetrating the depths had greater luck; they had just found Vima-Da-Boda when Fett attacked. His assault was defeated when Chewbacca ignited his jet-pack, sending the bounty hunter flying into a wall. However, their immediate departure was sabotaged by [[Mako Spince]], who from his perch in the Traffic Control spire forwarded their location to the waiting dark-siders aboard. Due to Han's risky maneuver, the group was able to destroy Spince and escape.

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Solo and Chewbacca were taken prisoner on the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and forced to work in the fathomless depths of a spice mine. On Kessel they befriended a boy named [[Kyp Durron]]. Chewbacca and Han broke away and fled desperately to a secret Imperial research laboratory surrounded by a cluster of black holes. In the laboratory they discovered the dreadful [[Sun Crusher]]. After being captured by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala's]] forces, Chewbacca, along with Han, Kyp, and [[Qwi Xux]] stole the Sun Crusher and escaped the [[Maw Installation]]. Unfortunately, Kyp stole the Sun Crusher, destroying thousands of lives on the planet of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Chewbacca and Han eventually caught up with and took the latter to the Coruscant where he was redeemed by Luke Skywalker.

As Luke began restoring the Jedi Order and reversing the damages done by Darth Vader and the Emperor, Chewbacca and the Solos set out on their own mission to recover force-sensitive children. They began their search on the frozen world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], as they heard rumors of Jedi living there. Having heard tales of a Jedi exodus from the dark crypts below the planet's surface, and also hearing that since the time of the exodus no one entering the crypts has returned alive, Chewbacca, Han, and Leia, journeyed there to start their search. <!-- Needs some concluding details here from Children of the Jedi -->

[[File:Chewbacca_wounded.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chewbacca was wounded during the kidnapping of the Solo children.]]
He was seen as an uncle-like figure by the Solo children and took care of them along with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] when Han and Leia were away. Chewbacca was known to protect the Solo children rather fiercely as though they were his own children. In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] he accompanied Leia on her mission to rescue her children from Lord [[Hethrir]] and the [[Empire Reborn]] movement. Posing as pirates, Chewbacca and Leia managed to find and rescue Jaina and Jacen along with the other children Hethrir held on his [[Worldcraft]].<ref name="The Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>

Also in that year, Chewbacca was seen in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] in a mission for Leia Organa.
