Chewbacca was being chased by mercenaries, when he met Jedi apprentice [[Jaden Korr]], while hiding himself from the shooters. The Wookiee was of great help to Jaden's [[Mission to Mos Eisley (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|mission]], having neutralized many mercenaries and smugglers. By the end of it, [[Kyle Katarn]] met up with the two, and suspected that the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] was backing up the [[Disciples of Ragnos]]. Chewbacca complimented Jaden's skills, grabbed him and held his head, as a form of gratitude for the help.<ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

Just before the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], Chewbacca went home to Kashyyyk to participate in his son Lumpawarrump's coming of age ceremony. When Chewbacca learned that Han had been captured by the [[Yevetha]], he disobeyed Leia's instructions and [[Mission to the Koornacht Cluster|flew]] straight into the heart of enemy territory. Chewbacca staged a rescue from the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Pride of Yevetha'']] with the [[First Wookiee Expeditionary Force|help]] of his son and his cousins [[Jowdrrl]], [[Shoran]], and [[Dryanta]]. This served as a coming of age for Lumpawarrump, who was renamed Lumpawaroo as he became an adult.<ref name="TT" />

In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], Chewbacca accompanied the Solo family to Han's homeworld of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he and C-3PO looked after the twins and Anakin. When the first hostilities of the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]] broke out, Chewbacca got the children and others to the ''Falcon'' for a hasty retreat. They reached [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] after the ''Falcon''{{'s}} hyperdrive was damaged by a patrol ship. They went to Drall's planetary repulsor and were captured by their cousin [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]. The children escaped and made some repairs to the ''Falcon'' with Chewbacca's help. They flew off in the ''Falcon'' and evaded Thrackan's ship. Later the family was reunited.

After the discovery of a partial copy of the [[Caamas Document]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], and because of the crisis that would likely follow, the Solo children were sent to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] with Chewbacca and a group of Noghri for protection. After the crisis passed, Chewbacca and the children attended the signing of the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].

Shortly afterwards, Chewbacca's nephew [[Lowbacca]] was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], a trait rare among the Wookiee species. Chewbacca took Lowbacca to Luke's [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] where he built Lowbacca the droid [[M-TD]] to translate for him. Lowbacca later befriended the Solo twins, Jaina and Jacen, who affectionately called him Lowie.

====Mission to Sernpidal and aftermath====
{{Quote|You left him! You left Chewie!|Han to his son Anakin after Chewbacca's death|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Chewbacca_Sernpidal.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Chewbacca dies on Sernpidal.]]
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Chewbacca, Han Solo and his youngest son [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]] were sent by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to deliver a shipment to [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]. When they arrived, the Solos and Chewbacca met an old man, the former mayor of Sernpidal City, who informed them that Dobido was headed on a collision course with Sernpidal and that it was orbiting its host quickly, dropping closer to Sernpidal at regular intervals. While Chewbacca and Han began loading as many people as they could onto the ''Falcon'', Anakin rushed off into Sernpidal City with the mayor in tow. Chewbacca and Solo evacuated as many people as they could hold, rescuing thousands of [[Sernpidalian]]s, using the ''Millennium Falcon'' and various other starships.

Anakin calculated Dobido would collide with Sernpidal in seven hours. [[Destruction of Sernpidal|This event]], unbeknownst to them, was a result of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] tactic, [[Yo'gand's Core]]. As the winds picked up, Anakin was knocked into the distance, causing Chewbacca to run after him. Chewbacca was able to bring Anakin to safety on the ''Falcon'', but another blast of wind knocked him out of reach. Anakin piloted the ''Falcon'', while his father stood on the entrance ramp hoping to lift Chewbacca up, but was forced to flee from Sernpidal when he realized it was too late to save Chewbacca. The Wookiee stood in the moon's trajectory, howling defiantly, and was crushed to death with those Sernpidalians who could not escape. His death drove Han to a resentment of his son Anakin. Han eventually recovered and forgave his son, but the death of his battle-brother and dearest companion would stick with him forever.

===Honoring the legacy and death (25 ABY&mdash;)===
{{Quote|I love you, Chewie.''"<br />"''I should have told him that myself! He saved my children! He was always there for them, he ''died'' for them! And I never told him.|Han Solo to C-3PO and R2-D2 on Chewbacca|<ref name="SW-Chew" />}}
[[File:ChewbaccaMemorial-Chewbacca2.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Chewbacca is memorialized on Kashyyyk.]]
After his death, Chewbacca became a legend on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and the droid [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] recited his tale on occasions.<ref name="SW-Chew" /> His death solidified not only Anakin's cause to fight in the war but the rest of his family as well. With the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Lumpawaroo and Lowbacca, Chewbacca's son and nephew, vowed to take up his life-debt to Han Solo. Chewbacca's family gave Han the first bowcaster that Chewbacca ever made as a gift to his long time friend and co-pilot. Han even swore that Chewbacca spoke to him through the Force after he died, saving his life from [[Elan]], a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] assassin. To commemorate his heroic efforts, the villagers of Kashyyyk built a memorial in his honor, which was personally carved by [[Tvrrdko]] into a large [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr tree]]. The memorial was visited by many well after his death. Han again visited the tree memorial of Chewbacca and stabbed [[Anakin Solo]]'s lightsaber deep into the tree, so that anyone who would need it in the future could use it. To honor Chewbacca's life, C-3PO and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] decided to create a holo featuring the interviews of the people that knew him the most.<ref name="SW-Chew" /> A [[Funeral of Chewbacca|funeral]] also took place.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref> To many, Chewbacca embodied a sense of courage and loyalty that made him a hero to others.

The Trandoshan Bossk had other thoughts. He couldn't help but rub Chewbacca's death in Han Solo's face. Both ended up in a fistfight, and Bossk ended up with a broken snout, courtesy of Solo. Wookiees would take pride in the fact that Chewbacca died honoring his life debt as well as the fact that it literally took an entire [[Dobido|moon]] to kill him.

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Chewie_pulls_droid_arm_off.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Chewbacca angrily pulls a droid's arm out of its socket over a [[Hologame table/Legends|holoboard]] game.]]
{{Quote|Always thinking with your stomach.|Han Solo to Chewbacca|audio=AlwaysThinkingWithYourStomach.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />}}
In his youth, Chewbacca was often found by many to be somewhat reckless, often venturing off into the Shadowlands on Kashyyyk. At the time of the Clone Wars, his leadership of his fellow brethren helped stop the Confederate forces from taking their home. Known for his great strength, bravery and loyalty, Chewbacca often served as Solo's conscience in their smuggling endeavors. However, he was also known for his stubbornness and dislike of losing.

One of the greatest heroes the galaxy had ever known, Chewbacca possessed a great amount of strength which was admired by many. In addition, Chewbacca possessed exceptional skills in piloting and repair and was a master of [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]], an ancient and challenging hologame requiring skill and strategy. Many of the sublight and hyperdrive systems of the ''Falcon'' were of Chewbacca's own design. Even when the ship was in peak condition, he enjoyed attempting to upgrade and re-route the engines for greater efficiency and performance. Chewbacca has taken the ''Falcon''{{'s}} engines apart on several occasions and had a great understanding of the temperamental nature of its systems. He understood small craft such as the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|Sorosuub]] [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]] and the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|Imperial AT-ST]], and had intuitive ability to understand the workings of other vehicles, as situations arose. Chewbacca's technical skill and precision allowed him to understand the inner workings of a great number of devices, from droids to star cruisers. Chewbacca learned his skills at Rwookrrorro's landing pad, and helped design and build the Wookiee escape pods.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I sat down on one of the sofas, waiting for George. Door opened, and George walked in with Gary behind him. So, naturally, what did I do? I'm raised in England. Soon as someone comes in through the door, I stand up. George goes "Hmm&hellip;". Virtually turned to Gary, and said 'I think we've found him'.|Peter Mayhew, about his audition|<ref name="Empire of Dreams">''[[Empire of Dreams: The Story of the Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>}}
[[File:ChewieConceptArt.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Early Chewbacca concept art]]
Chewbacca was portrayed by [[Peter Mayhew]] in ''Episodes III'' to ''VI''. He was based on [[Indiana]], an [[Wikipedia:Alaskan malamute|Alaskan malamute]] [[Dog/Legends|dog]] owned by [[George Lucas]] in the [[Wikipedia:1970s|1970s]], the name of whom later provided [[Indiana Jones|Dr. Henry Jones Junior's]] adopted first name.

[[File:Chewnewlarge.jpg|thumb|150px|John Schoenherr's illustration (left) and Ralph McQuarrie's Chewbacca concept art (right)]]
There were many early versions of Chewbacca's appearance (including one piece of concept art that eventually became the basis of the [[Lasat/Legends|Lasat]]). His final appearance in the movie is based on a 1976 piece of concept art by [[Ralph McQuarrie]], which in turn was based on an illustration by John Schoenherr for George R.R. Martin's novelette "And Seven Times Never Kill a Man," published in the July 1975 issue of ''Analog''. The Schoenherr illustration also includes a weapon that became an inspiration for Chewbacca's bowcaster.<ref name="BinaryBonsai">{{WebCite|url=http://binarybonsai.com/2010/09/18/george-lucas-stole-chewbacca-but-its-okay|text=George Lucas Stole Chewbacca, But It's Okay|work=binarybonsai.com|archivedate=20101009024242}}</ref>

For his appearances in the [[original trilogy]], the Chewbacca suit, designed by [[Stuart Freeborn]], was made out of knitted mohair (made from goat and rabbit hair) and yak hair. It was later used and retouched during the making of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]]. For his appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], Chewbacca was completely remade, with newer, more efficient and cost-effective materials. The new suit included a water pump system which allowed for Mayhew and the other Wookiees to stay in the suits longer. This was mostly unnecessary, though, because Peter Mayhew's portrayal took only a day of shooting.

The memorable voice of Chewbacca was designed by [[Ben Burtt]], sound designer for all six films. He mixed together various animal growls for different emotions, including those of walruses, bears, tigers, camels and badgers. The most prominent of these voices was a [[Wikipedia:Black bear|black bear]] named [[Tarik]], who died of congestive heart failure in [[1994]].

[[File:Chewie_suit_btm.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The parts making up the Chewbacca costume]]

In [[1997]], Chewbacca appeared on the [[Wikipedia:MTV Movie Awards|MTV Movie Awards]] and, as recompense for not receiving a medal during the closing sequence of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], was given a medal by [[Carrie Fisher]], who played [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] throughout the original trilogy.

In [[1999]], Chewbacca became the first major character in the ''Star Wars'' films to be killed off<ref name=":0" /> (not counting Palpatine’s resurrections and subsequent final demise in the Dark Empire comics series)<ref>''[[Empire's End 2|Empire’s End 2]]''</ref> in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]], when [[R. A. Salvatore]]'s ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', the first entry in the [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''New Jedi Order series'']], depicted him being crushed by [[Dobido]], one of two moons of [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]. This caused resentment and drama against Salvatore among some fans despite the fact that the idea originated with [[Randy Stradley]], well before Salvatore was even signed on to the series. It was only after he signed on to his contractual obligations that Salvatore was informed that Chewbacca was to die. The author decided that since his contract was forcing him to kill off a character he liked, he would ensure that Chewbacca would go out in an heroic and unforgettable blaze of glory. Chewbacca's death in the novel received widespread coverage in the form of articles, memorials, and tributes by newspapers across the United States.<ref name=":0">{{JCFCite|date=2021-05-22|time=2:44 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210326232446/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/flashback-national-newspaper-coverage-of-the-finale-of-vector-prime-chewbacca.50055882|board=Literature|thread=Flashback: National Newspaper Coverage of the Finale of "Vector Prime"/Chewbacca|user=xezene|url=threads/50055882}}</ref>

In the [[Wikipedia:Super Nintendo Entertainment System|Super Nintendo Entertainment System|Super Nintendo]] ''[[Super Star Wars (series)|Super Star Wars]]'' games, Chewbacca is listed as being eight feet tall, 200 years old and originating from the planet "[[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kazhyyyk]]," an early way the Expanded Universe spelled the planet.

[[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]] wanted to rewrite Chewbacca's family (such as making it polygamous) for the [[The Black Fleet Crisis|''Black Fleet Crisis Trilogy'']], but was forced by [[Lucasfilm]] to follow the background given in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.lucasfan.com/swtv/index3.html|text=Star Wars Holiday Special Opinions|work=[https://web.archive.org/web/19981212015351/http://lucasfan.com LucasFan.com]|archivedate=20200120144211|nolive=1}}</ref>

Chewbacca made an appearance in ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' on the Kashyyyk segment, although he was not specifically identified in the ride itself. Rather, he was identified by various Disney promotional materials, specifying him as the Wookiee who slammed into the Star Tours vessel at one point.

===Non-canon content===
====The Battle of Endor====
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
{{Quote|CHEWIE!|Han Solo, right after accidentally killing Chewbacca while fighting the Dark Apprentice|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
Through the [[Canon|non-canon]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] ending of [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II|The Force Unleashed II]], the events at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] were drastically altered as a consequence of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Assault on Kamino|defeat]] at [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and [[Subject 1138|Starkiller's]] choosing of vengeance. Although much of the battle was similar to its canonical counterpart, the main difference was in the form of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Dark Apprentice]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] personal [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] and the only perfect [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Galen Marek|original Starkiller]]. With orders from Vader to prevent the Rebel forces from destroying the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]], the apprentice did not hold back from rampaging his way through the forest, slaughtering [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troops]] and [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] alike.<ref name="DLC">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' DLC</ref>

Upon reaching the entrance of the bunker, the Dark Apprentice's path was blocked by the Rebel [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Chewbacca. While standing above the bunker with a rocket launcher, Solo warned his friend that the clone was approaching and that they had to do everything that they could to buy the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] more time to complete the mission. To aid in their effort, Chewbacca utilized a commandeered [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST walker]]. Although a combination of the walker's heavy firepower and quick shots from Han Solo was able to stall the apprentice, neither Solo nor Chewbacca was able to kill the clone.<ref name="DLC" />

After suffering damage to the walker, Chewbacca called upon the aid of the Ewoks. Once more, their tactics proved ineffective against Vader's disciple, who managed to kill the native creatures while simultaneously warding off shots from Solo and Chewbacca. After inflicting even more damage to the walker, the clone wasted little time in maneuvering his way over to the top of the walker. Once the hatch was open, the clone began pulling its Rebel occupant out of the cockpit. Chewbacca attempted to resist by relying on his brute strength, but was effectively incapacitated by the apprentice with one swift punch to the face. Unable to resist any further, Chewbacca was rendered helpless as the clone raised and held the Wookiee by the throat with one hand.<ref name="DLC" />

Solo attempted to save his friend by firing two shots at the clone. But the Dark Apprentice anticipated this action and quickly used the Wookiee as a body shield to absorb the attack, thus causing Solo to inadvertently kill Chewbacca. With Chewbacca [[Death/Legends|dead]], Han Solo quickly followed as the clone impaled the [[Smuggler/Legends|former smuggler]] through the chest with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Their failure to kill or prevent the Dark Apprentice from entering the bunker led to Leia's death and the Empire's decisive victory over the fallen Alliance.<ref name="DLC" />

Chewbaaca also appears during the special ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Padawan Menace]]'', where he is in the Senate building during a session and in the audience of the medal ceremony at the end.
In [[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles (book)|''LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles'']] book, Chewbacca states that he knows where Yoda comes from, however, he also says that he will not reveal it.<ref name="YODACHR">[[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles (book)|''LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles'' book]]</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}

===Translations===
*In Italian, Chewbacca, is named '''Chewbecca''' (also nicknamed "'''Giube'''" or "'''Ciube'''").
*Initially, in French, Chewbacca was called '''Chiktabba''', or '''Chiquetaba''' (from "chique taba," "chew tobacco" in French).
*Initially, in Czech, Chewbacca was called '''Žvejkal''' or '''Žvejk'''.
*The [[Shyriiwook]] translation of Chewbacca's name is "honored ally" (similar to "Kemo-sabe", Tonto's name for the Lone Ranger, which translates as "trusted friend").
